text:
mike: heads-up: we've been getting a spike of fncall validation errors that are being classified as "soft-reject" and showing up as "user errors" in the dashboard. customers keep raising billing confusion.

lina: ugh, yeah saw that. examples?

mike: one common one is when tool returns an array instead of object. our validator currently marks as soft-reject, still returns model output via fallback route, but we tag the route as "invocations.failed_validation" which increments quota counters.

sam: can you paste a minimal repro?

mike: sure:

```json
{"tool_response": [ {"id": 1, "text": "ok"} ] }
```

mike: validator schema expects an object: 

```json
{"type": "object", "properties": {"id": {"type": "integer"}, "text": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["id", "text"]}
```

eden: quick Q: why are soft-rejects incrementing the same billing metric as hard-rejects? that seems like the root cause of customer confusion.

lina: historical reason: we treated any schema deviation as "invalid invocation" for accounting simplicity. but we never surfaced the difference in the console.

sam: proposal: split metrics into invoke.validator.hard_rejects and invoke.validator.soft_rejects and map billing->hard_rejects only. soft_rejects remain visible but not billable.

mike: agree on metrics split. also need better UX in console: right now both show under "Errors" list with same red badge. we should change soft->amber "Validation warning" with tooltip explaining fallback behavior.

lina: telemetry ask: add validator.reject_reason tag (enum: schema_mismatch, missing_field, wrong_type, extra_root_array, parse_error) and include original route_id and model_variant. sampling: record full payload for 1% of soft_rejects, 100% of hard_rejects.

sam: +1 for sampling. also add a new histogram metric validator.strictness_score so we can track how often our coercion heuristics are activated.

eden: there's a rollout risk: if we change billing mapping we need a canary and customer notification. who owns billing mapping change? finance + billing-api.

mike: I'll loop in @payments. rollout plan idea: 2-week canary: 10% accounts see new billing mapping (hard_only), 90% unchanged. expose a UI toggle per-account in console for early opt-in. canary toggle name: fncall-validator-billing-mode.

lina: also need an API flag for SDKs: validator_mode: ["strict","permissive"] so customers can opt-in/out programmatically. default stays current behavior until canary completes.

sam: ops impact: routing policies—some routes currently fallback to degen path which isn't charged. We must ensure the new classification doesn't accidentally route traffic to degen and change latency SLAs. add route policy test: if validator.soft_reject -> fallback route unchanged. only billing tag changes.

mike: agreed. implementer notes: validator returns object

```json
{"status":"soft_reject","reason":"extra_root_array","coerced": true, "fallback_route":"fallback-v1", "sampled_payload_id":"abc123"}
```

eden: ok but we need to make sure console search works: customers will search "validation" and should see both warnings and errors. maybe two tabs: Warnings / Errors. Warnings sorted by frequency.

lina: UX mock: show warning with small "Did you mean to return an object?" help link and a CTA "Mark stable" which creates a validation exception for that tool signature.
sam: metrics/alerts: set alert if hard_reject rate > 0.05% of invocations for any route over 5m window. set separate noisy alert for soft_reject surge but with higher threshold.
mike: action items:
- mike: create PR to add new metrics and validator.reject_reason tag
- lina: prototype console UI change (Warnings tab + per-account toggle)
- sam: add sampling pipeline and histogram metric
- eden: draft canary plan and ping payments/billing

eden: can we add a short-term mitigation? maybe stop counting soft_rejects towards quota immediately behind a feature flag. roll that out internally first.
lina: yes feature flag fncall-softreject-billing-off -> default off.

ops-bot: ACTION_SUMMARY: mike -> fncall validator metrics PR; lina -> console mock; sam -> sampling infra; eden -> canary + billing contact. ETA initial prototypes in 3d.
mike: I'll start PR and tag folks. thanks. :thumbsup:

lina: thanks all. will sync tomorrow in eng-platform standup.

ops-bot: NOTE: created issue #INF-8421 and scheduled canary job job-validate-billing-canary for 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC.
